intro: Locate name, age, city and languages on a short form. Read the French first; open the translation when you want to check your understanding.

texto: Locate name, age, city and languages on a short form. First look for names, days, places and figures: in notices and forms these are usually easy to find.
Point to note: form questions are usually followed by names, figures or one-word answers. In this passage, «prénom» means «first name».
